query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.source_pages WHERE source_page BETWEEN 704 AND 708) AS source_pages, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.gk_facts WHERE source_page BETWEEN 704 AND 708) AS facts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.gk_notes WHERE source_page BETWEEN 704 AND 708) AS notes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.gk_mcqs WHERE source_page BETWEEN 704 AND 708) AS mcqs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.gk_mcq_options o JOIN public.gk_mcqs m ON m.id=o.mcq_id WHERE m.source_page BETWEEN 704 AND 708) AS mcq_options, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.gk_mcq_sources s JOIN public.gk_mcqs m ON m.id=s.mcq_id WHERE m.source_page BETWEEN 704 AND 708) AS mcq_sources, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.fact_verifications WHERE source_page BETWEEN 704 AND 708) AS verifications, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.flashcards WHERE source_key LIKE 'batch0704-0708:%') AS flashcards, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.search_documents d JOIN public.gk_facts f ON d.entity_type='fact' AND d.entity_id=f.id WHERE f.source_page BETWEEN 704 AND 708) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.search_documents d JOIN public.gk_mcqs m ON d.entity_type='mcq' AND d.entity_id=m.id WHERE m.source_page BETWEEN 704 AND 708) AS search_documents, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.content_tag_assignments a JOIN public.gk_facts f ON a.entity_type='fact' AND a.entity_id=f.id WHERE f.source_page BETWEEN 704 AND 708) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.content_tag_assignments a JOIN public.gk_mcqs m ON a.entity_type='mcq' AND a.entity_id=m.id WHERE m.source_page BETWEEN 704 AND 708) AS tag_assignments LIMIT 1;
